name: Cellular Graphs Are Strictly Polat
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every finite cellular bipartite graph is a Polat graph, and the containment is strict.
proof: Cellular graphs exclude $Q_3^-$ and $Q_3$, hence satisfy the Polat exclusions. The cube $Q_3$ is median and therefore Polat, but it is not cellular.
